obligations: Select the contract source explicitly through the application's configured binding.
Supply a nonempty string contract_id and version, using exact opaque values rather than a version selector.
Interpret a missing result only as absence of that exact identity/version in the selected source.
Keep invalid_arguments, contract_unavailable, contract_denied, contract_invalid and contract_resolver_closed distinct from absence.
Do not treat a resolved definition as approval, compatibility evidence, or proof that either role conforms.
Release the resolver's owned resources when the binding is no longer needed.
Resolve contract_id and version exactly, without normalization, aliasing, version ordering, implicit latest selection, or fallback.

Return a detached JSON contract-definition v1 object whose id and version match the request, preserving both named roles, every obligation, and all optional native artifacts including their source text and selectors.
Preserve native artifact formats opaquely, including unknown formats; do not execute, convert, default, or claim conformance from their contents.
Keep published content unchanged for an identity/version within the selected source; caller mutation must never change source content or later results.

Return a missing result only for known absence; report invalid_arguments for empty or non-string identity/version, contract_unavailable for an unanswerable source, contract_denied for refused access, and contract_invalid for malformed or unsupported definitions.
Release owned resources on close, allow repeated close, and refuse subsequent resolution with contract_resolver_closed.
